in_sanskrit.name: Anash
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Breath of Life
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Anash एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Anash is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Anas' which means 'Breath' or 'Life'. This name signifies the vital energy that sustains all life forms. In Hindu mythology, the god Anash is believed to be the embodiment of the life force, nourishing and protecting all beings.
